## Advice types

| Annotation | When it runs |
|------------|--------------|
| `@Before` | Before method |
| `@AfterReturning` | After success |
| `@AfterThrowing` | After exception |
| `@After` | After finally (success or fail) |
| `@Around` | Full control; must `proceed()` |

```java
@Around("execution(* com.example.demo.service.*.*(..))")
public Object time(ProceedingJoinPoint pjp) throws Throwable {
    long t = System.currentTimeMillis();
    try {
        return pjp.proceed();
    } finally {
        System.out.println(pjp.getSignature() + " " + (System.currentTimeMillis()-t) + "ms");
    }
}
```

## Practice

Time all service methods with `@Around`. Add `@Before` that logs method name.
